# Command-line reference

Every command of the `pygeovision` tool, generated from the installed code. For a task-oriented introduction see the [Quickstart](../../getting-started/quickstart.md).

```bash
pygeovision --version
pygeovision --help
pygeovision <group> --help
```

Add `-v` / `--verbose` before the command for detailed logging.

There are **25 command groups** and **92 commands**.

| Group | What it is for | Commands |
|---|---|---|
| [`ai`](ai.md) | Geospatial AI commands — fully native (SAM, YOLO, ChangeFormer, CLIP). | 8 |
| [`ai-models`](ai-models.md) | AI model management commands (legacy AI-engine registry). | 3 |
| [`benchmark`](benchmark.md) | Benchmarking tools — evaluate models, compare results, generate leaderboards. | 3 |
| [`channel`](channel.md) | Run an end-to-end geospatial pipeline by name. | 1 |
| [`cloud`](cloud.md) | Cloud deployment — AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, GCP Vertex AI. | 2 |
| [`data`](data.md) | Satellite data commands — powered by pygeofetch. | 14 |
| [`datasets`](datasets.md) | Browse and search a catalogue of about 460 remote sensing datasets (metadata only; nothing is downloaded). | 8 |
| [`doctor`](doctor.md) | Diagnose PyGeoVision installation and all component connectivity. | 1 |
| [`edge`](edge.md) | Edge deployment — ONNX export, Jetson conversion. | 2 |
| [`explain`](explain.md) | Explainability — GradCAM saliency maps (SHAP, uncertainty and attention maps are Python APIs). | 1 |
| [`indices`](indices.md) | Compute validated spectral indices (NDVI, EVI, NBR, TCT, PCA …). | 3 |
| [`infer`](infer.md) | Run AI inference on satellite imagery. | 2 |
| [`label`](label.md) | Auto-labeling from OSM, satellite data, and foundation models. | 2 |
| [`models`](models.md) | Model registry commands — list, info, download architectures. | 4 |
| [`monitor`](monitor.md) | Model monitoring — drift detection, performance tracking. | 1 |
| [`obia`](obia.md) | Object-based image analysis — segment, describe, classify, assess. | 7 |
| [`pipeline`](pipeline.md) | Pipeline management — create, run, schedule workflows. | 2 |
| [`postprocess`](postprocess.md) | Postprocess model predictions — vectorise, smooth, statistics, export. | 9 |
| [`preprocess`](preprocess.md) | Satellite image preprocessing — stack, clip, mask, normalise, resample. | 5 |
| [`report`](report.md) | Rebuild the map, vectors and reports of an earlier pipeline run. | 1 |
| [`status`](status.md) | Show PyGeoVision, pygeofetch, and native AI stack status. | 1 |
| [`timeseries`](timeseries.md) | Time series of a spectral index over a stack of images: per-date statistics, trend, anomalies. | 2 |
| [`validate`](validate.md) | Validate satellite data before model inference. | 2 |
| [`vlm`](vlm.md) | Vision-Language Models — caption, query, search imagery. | 3 |
| [`zoo`](zoo.md) | Browse the AI Model Zoo, a metadata catalogue of about 96 architectures (it describes models; it does not build them). | 5 |
